g.text: Crystal momentum / wave vector, k (schematic path)
Crystalline silicon: schematic indirect band gap
CB minimum along Delta toward X
Schematic only: curvatures and k positions are not a numerical E(k) calculation.
Si is indirect because the valence-band maximum and conduction-band minimum occur at different k.
